name: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing
capabilities: Design and development of IT-based solutions
Fabrication, assembly, testing of electronic boards (inferred)
india_angle: C-DAC is an Indian R&D institution under the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology, focusing on advanced computing and IT solutions.
summary: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) is an Indian R&D institution involved in the design and development of advanced IT solutions, including supercomputing and real-time systems. While its primary focus is not on semiconductors, it engages in some activities related to electronic board fabrication and testing.
